title: Value-Focused KV-Cache Compression for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
venue: Prepared for ACL Rolling Review (Work in Progress)
summary: This research introduces a novel, value-focused key-value (KV) cache compression technique aimed at optimizing long-context inference in Large Language Models (LLMs). By dynamically evaluating token importance based on attention weight distribution and value vectors during runtime, we compress the key-value cache up to 4x with negligible loss in perplexity. This significantly increases token throughput and reduces memory footprints for long-context generation tasks.
